about: Visit rules that end on a date (from November 17, 2026). SLATE-REBUILD's visit records (visits.json) give each rule as it stood when researched, and their notes say when a temporary one ends; until this table the game applied them for ever. Each rule here names the destination, the passports, the last day it is in force, and the rule after it, with the source that gives the date. A renewal announced later is new research, not assumed.
